style: Warm, whimsical children's picture-book illustration. Soft painterly digital art with visible brushwork, gentle golden-hour lighting, a cozy and inviting color palette. Friendly, rounded character design. Single clear scene, no text or watermarks, no panel borders.
characters: A warm family of four in a small cozy house: Mother has curly dark hair and a soft yellow cardigan; Father has short black hair, glasses, and a blue sweater; the child narrator is a cheerful kid in a striped shirt; the little sister has pigtails and a pink dress and a fluffy grey cat.
cover: The whole family standing together in front of their small cottage-style house at sunset, warm light glowing from the windows, everyone smiling.
pages: A cozy small house with a garden, warm light in the windows, evening sky, inviting and homely.
Mother sitting in a comfortable armchair by a sunlit window, reading a book, a warm cup of tea beside her.
Father sitting at a wooden desk near a lamp, working thoughtfully, a small potted plant on the table.
The little sister sitting on the floor, gently petting a fluffy grey cat curled up beside her, soft afternoon light.
The whole family together in the living room, laughing and hugging, warm lamp light, a sense of love and togetherness.
